sections.title: About the role

Build robust reporting and analytics to identify recurring customer challenges, measure operational performance, and drive continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to communicate customer pain points, identify systemic issues, and influence product improvements based on customer feedback.
Guide the team through complex debugging, root-cause analysis, and customer escalations involving distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI workloads.

ashby:benchling:d2e3176f-beea-4827-a4ba-.summary:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is…

sections.title: ROLE OVERVIEW
paras: Benchling is building a world-class Customer Experience organization to drive the adoption of our platform across our rapidly growing customer base. The Technical Account Manager (TAM) plays a key role within the Optimization Services organization through directly supporting our customers as they leverage Benchling to transform how their research teams work together, post-go-live.

This role is based in Boston and will serve as the primary TAM supporting Benchling’s customer base, with an emphasis on enterprise life science accounts. The successful candidate will bring existing Benchling product expertise and the ability to quickly take ownership of an established book of business, including accounts with complex, multi-workstream Success Packages.

The TAM works closely with Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support, in order to deliver a high quality, proactive Benchling experience for our customers. This role requires strong scientific acumen, project management skills, the ability to build trust with stakeholders ranging from bench scientists to heads of R&D and IT leadership.

paras: Develop and maintain deep relationships with our customers, including scientists, heads of research, IT managers, and other stakeholders.
bullets: Act as the main point of contact for Success Package delivery post-go-live; manage multiple accounts simultaneously with minimal oversight
Proactively partner with customers, CX stakeholders and sales to optimize customers Benchling’s instance to ensure success, engagement, and influence expansion outcomes.
Proactively identify, communicate, and mitigate potential risks and issues that could impact customer success (budget, scope, product gaps, adoption)

Lead and execute projects and assignments as needed, including configuration and maintenance of customer Benchling tenant, dedicated follow up tasks, process documentation, new product area enablement, and delivery of project accelerators
Proactively maintain and grow product knowledge, services delivery knowledge, and offerings to best support our customers.
Develop and manage project plans for customer engagements, including defining scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables for Optimization Services Accelerators.

sections.title: QUALIFICATIONS
paras: 2+ Years active Benchling experience required – candidates must demonstrate hands-on familiarity with Benchling and the ability to independently lead customer-facing Benchling engagements.
bullets: BS or M.Sc . in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, Bioengineering, or similar life science field, required.
Experience in a lab or research setting; ability to empathize with scientists and can quickly understand complicated scientific concepts.
Skilled in internal business systems and project management tools, including LucidChart, Smartsheets, Jira, Certinia, etc.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; you are an excellent presenter and can quickly connect with a range of industry stakeholders, including scientists, project leads, and executives leadership.
Autonomous and proactive; outstanding self-starter approach with the ability to be successful in a high-growth environment.
Curious, creative, and tenacious; you are an advocate for customers and roll up your sleeves to help get a problem solved or a customer on-boarded.

ashby:cardless:1cb09d16-b7dd-446d-bbff-6.summary:
Cardless is building the infrastructure for the world's best companies to design, build, and launch financial products. Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. Our APIs and components shape the journey from the first application to every purchase, reward, and moment of support that follows, while we handle lending, compliance, and operations behind the scenes.

In September 2025, we raised a $60 million Series C led by Spark Capital, bringing our total funding to $170 million. The team is over 70 people and scaling toward profitability by year-end 2026.

sections.title: About Cardless
paras: We're looking for kind, humble people with high standards and low egos. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We see what could be improved, make it so, and leave every product, system, and team better than we found it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Cardless is at an inflection point: the company has found product-market fit, raised the capital to scale, and is now executing against a clear roadmap to profitability. The work is consequential and the pace is fast. Launches are the moments the whole company organizes around, and this role sits at the center of every one.

And nobody runs launches forever. After a few of them you will understand how this entire business works better than almost anyone, and success looks like graduating into another part of the company - maybe a functional area you connected with along the way, maybe full oversight of one of our brand programs. People who have sat in this seat have gone on to senior operating and product roles here, and we expect the same for you.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets:
Run launches end to end

• Own the launch plan for new brand programs from signed deals to cards in wallets - the timeline, the dependencies, the DRIs, and the single source of truth everyone works from.

Manage and execute the launch process and associated trackers on a daily basis: daily standups, partner syncs, and executive updates. Everyone should always know what's on track, what's at risk, and what you need from them.
Find blockers early and clear them yourself where you can - and when you do need to escalate, come with a proposed answer.

Go deep on every workflow

• Learn (and track) how each function does its part of a launch: credit policy and underwriting setup, program configuration, rewards design, funding and settlement, compliance and bank approvals, fraud controls, servicing readiness, and card fulfillment.

Get into the details other people skip - the disclosure that hasn't been reviewed, the test case nobody ran, the vendor deliverable with no owner. Launches fail on small details, and it's your job to catch them.

Coordinate partners and vendors

• Act as the launch-facing point of contact for the brand partner's team, and manage the shared plan across both companies.
Coordinate deliverables across the issuing bank, card networks, processors, and vendors - each with their own timelines, requirements, and quirks.
Keep external parties honest on dates the same way you do internal teams.

sections.title: What we are looking for
bullets: 2–6 years in roles where you shipped complex cross-functional work: launch or program management, operations, consulting, banking, or early-stage startup operating roles.
You have run at least one project where five or more parties had to deliver on the same date, and you were the person accountable for the whole thing.

Enough fintech, payments, or financial services exposure to know the terminology and what's what. You don't need to be an expert in underwriting or compliance or card fulfillment on day one - but you do need the curiosity to become one.

Detail oriented to an extreme: You read everything, and you notice when something doesn't add up - a date that quietly moved, a number that doesn't match the tracker, a requirement nobody actually closed out.

Comfortable across functions: You can follow an engineering conversation about an integration cutover and a compliance conversation about disclosures, and explain each side to the other. You won't be the expert in most of these rooms, but you can never be lost in them.
Calm when things break: Something always breaks close to launch. You re-plan, tell everyone what changed, and keep the room steady.

ashby:dave:f6331ba3-e7f6-4586-b3bd-def47.summary: Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave’s digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave’s offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option.

sections.title: Dave vs. Goliath. We’re Dave.
paras: Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most.

We’re hiring a Director of Product Management, Financial Platform to lead the banking, money movement, and ledger capabilities behind Dave’s member-facing products. You’ll set the platform’s strategic direction and lead a team of Product Managers across three platform squads.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Our Financial Platform is the foundation that helps Dave deliver affordable, transparent financial products. You’ll shape its multi-year roadmap while guiding major infrastructure milestones, including core migrations and internal ledger development. We need a leader who treats internal teams as customers and connects platform investments to financial integrity, product delivery, and unit economics. Noetic builds Mort, the access and indexing layer that sits on a company's network and connects to its systems: modern SaaS tools, internal databases, and the 20-year-old legacy systems behind them.

ashby:plane:5560f4ef-5cbc-4152-8920-d210.summary:
Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

sections.title: About Plane
paras: Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

sections.title: Humans and agents
paras: We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

sections.title: About the role

You will own a portfolio of accounts from onboarding through renewal, and you will be the person a customer calls when adoption stalls, not just when something breaks. You will work closely with sales on the handoff and with support and product when a customer's problem turns out to be a product problem. This role exists because a self-hosted, open-source product brings a different kind of customer, one who often has their own engineers already poking at the system, and keeping them successful takes more than a quarterly check-in call.

sections.title: About the role
paras: We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead our AI agent platform. This is the core of what we build: the speech and language models, the harness around them, and the language our agents are built in. You'll report to the VP of Product and work directly with our research and platform engineers.

The job is to build a future proof, durable, and platform that will scale. New models arrive constantly, and the technology is consistently changing how agents can work. We need a platform that takes those changes without forcing us to rebuild the agents running on it. That takes an opinionated point of view on how an AI agent should be assembled, and this role will help shepherd that strategy.

This is a role for someone who has built agents at scale and knows where they break. Platform work is hard and it doesn't always get the spotlight. If you want to be the person engineers come to with the hardest question about how our agents work, you'll like it here.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the agent platform strategy and roadmap. Set direction for the ASR/S2S, LLM, and TTS model layer, the harness, and the way our agents get built, balancing long-term technical bets with iterative delivery.

Set our point of view on how agents get assembled. Decide how an agent passes context, stores state, calls tools, and recovers when something goes wrong, then turn that into a framework people can build on.
Make the platform easy to evolve. Build the path for adopting new models safely, including a move from cascading models toward speech-to-speech where it makes sense.
Stay at the frontier and make the call. Track what's changing in LLMs, voice AI, and agent architectures. Decide where we build, partner, or integrate, and explain why.
Lead with engineering and research. Work inside the team, take a technical trade-off, and make it clear to everyone else who has to live with it.
Treat the people who build agents as your customers. Spend time with our agent engineers and with enterprise customers on live problems, then remove the workarounds they've had to create.
Define how we measure the platform. Own metrics for accuracy, task success, latency, reliability, and cost. Partner on the evals that tell us whether a change is safe to ship.
Raise the bar on the product team. Coach other PMs on AI and platform thinking, and help us hire.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: You've built AI agents yourself. You've designed and shipped an agent or agent system to production or real users, and you can walk through what broke and what you changed.

You have strong platform instincts. You've owned a technical platform, developer product, or ML product. You think about abstractions, versioning, migration, and the people building on top of what you ship.
You have real technical depth in AI. You can reason about context management, tool calling, orchestration, model limits, latency, and cost, and you have informed opinions about architecture.
You know how to test non-deterministic systems. You've created and used evals to make real ship decisions, and you know the difference between testing an outcome and testing an implementation.
You lead engineers through influence. Senior engineers have changed their minds because of your reasoning. You can describe a time you drove direction on something they already knew deeply.
You find the problems and set your own priorities. You bring clarity to ambiguous problems across multiple teams, and you can say what you chose not to do.
You work from data and from customers. You're comfortable pulling your own data, and you can point to a decision that changed because of it or because of a conversation you had.
You explain complicated things simply. Engineers, executives, and customers all leave the conversation understanding the trade-off.

ashby:snowflake:7576ec7f-01c9-41b9-b451-.summary: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. sections.title: What you will do
bullets: Set product direction. Develop a clear product vision, strategy, roadmap, and narrative for a meaningful business problem. Define the outcomes that matter, the choices required to achieve them, and the principles that guide trade-offs.

Partner directly with the business. Work side by side with business leaders, operators, and end users from problem framing through launch and adoption. Build shared ownership of the problem and the solution rather than taking orders or handing off requirements.

Build world-class products. Apply strong product judgment, user-centered discovery, and first-principles thinking to create simple, intuitive products that solve important problems and earn sustained adoption.

Redesign workflows end to end. Start with the desired business outcome, not the existing application or process. Decide what should disappear, what should be redesigned, and where software or agents can handle work end to end.

Prototype rapidly. Use AI tooling and modern product-development techniques to turn ideas into working prototypes quickly. Put prototypes in front of users, learn from real behavior, and use evidence to decide what to build, change, or stop.

Lead AI-native product development. Define and ship production-grade agents and intelligent workflows that use trusted enterprise context and tools, operate within clear guardrails, manage exceptions, explain their actions, and bring people into the loop when judgment is required.

Lead the product-engineering partnership. Work closely with engineering, design, data science, security, and platform teams on architecture and delivery trade-offs, including context retrieval, orchestration, tool integration, evaluation, reliability, latency, privacy, and cost.

Create alignment through storytelling. Make complex problems and technical possibilities understandable. Communicate a compelling product narrative, facilitate hard decisions, align executives and delivery teams, and keep stakeholders current with clear, concise communication.

Strong product judgment: the ability to identify the highest-value problem, challenge solution-shaped requests, make trade-offs, and focus teams on outcomes.

Experience partnering directly with business teams and users to discover problems, test assumptions, shape solutions, and drive adoption. You can earn trust with both senior executives and frontline practitioners.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You can simplify complexity, create a compelling point of view, write clearly, present with confidence, and align people around a direction.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to rapidly prototype, test, and refine software solutions. You are comfortable learning new tools and turning an ambiguous idea into something users can react to.

Technical fluency in modern AI and software product development, including LLM and agent patterns, orchestration, tools, retrieval, evaluation, data, APIs, security, and production operations. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to lead an informed technical conversation and make sound product trade-offs.
Experience taking products from discovery and zero-to-one development through launch, adoption, iteration, and scale.
The ability to thrive in ambiguity, create clarity, move quickly, and make hard decisions with incomplete information.

Celero Communications is building the next generation of intelligent optical connectivity for AI infrastructure.

Founded in 2024 by industry pioneers from Broadcom, Inphi, Marvell, and ClariPhy, Celero brings together decades of coherent DSP innovation with a focused mission to deliver the optical performance, power efficiency, and scalability required for tomorrow's AI-driven data centers.

We believe the future of AI infrastructure will be defined not only by speed, but by intelligence, energy efficiency, and the ability to seamlessly move massive amounts of data across increasingly complex networks.

Our mission is to build the technology foundation that makes this possible.

sections.title: About Celero
paras: Headquartered in Irvine, California, with engineering teams in Canada and Argentina, Celero develops advanced coherent Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions that enable high-bandwidth, low-power optical connectivity for hyperscale AI infrastructure.

paras: Celero is seeking an entrepreneurial, commercially-driven Director of Product Marketing to build and lead the global go-to-market strategy for our next-generation Digital Signal Processor (DSP) product line. As an early-stage leader in our high-growth startup, you will have a massive impact on our trajectory. You will bridge advanced chip design with global market adoption, turning our technical architecture into compelling commercial solutions. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, this role requires a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to draft technical whitepapers, launch global campaigns, and secure anchor customer design wins.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Corporate Strategy Support: Execute Celero's overall marketing strategy to support corporate growth, product adoption, and brand awareness.
Strategic Roadmapping: Define the multi-year vision, business cases, and product roadmap based on market data and ROI.
Commercialization: Develop pricing strategies, margin targets, value propositions, and go-to-market (GTM) plans.

Product Positioning & Messaging: Translate complex DSP architecture into high-impact value propositions for engineering executives and architects. Translate Hyperscaler networking requirements into DSP performance specifications and feature set.

Inbound Market Intelligence: Act as the strategic filter for R&D. Gather customer/end user/ecosystem feedback and competitive intelligence to shape our silicon development and future roadmap.

greenhouse:databricks:8560772002.summary:
Location: San Francisco or Mountain View, California

Databricks is building an Agentic Enterprise applications Platform a scalable, governed AI application platform built on Databricks that enables any internal team (GTM, Finance, HR, Legal, Product) to build production grade agentic applications in weeks, not months. The platform provides a managed agent runtime, standardized MCP connectors to enterprise systems of record, a shared UI component library with a design system, an intelligence data/context layer and a gold-standard promotion pipeline from prototype to production.

As a Staff Product Manager , you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Agentic Platform the foundational layer that every domain workspace depends on. You will work across agent runtime, MCP connectors, intelligence layer, evaluation framework, developer experience, and governance to…

sections.title: The impact you will have:
bullets: Own the Agentic Platform strategy and roadmap. Define what ships, in what order, and why. Translate organizational outcomes into concrete platform capabilities with measurable success criteria.

Define and drive the agent and runtime. Establish the managed agent runtime supporting multi step orchestration with durable execution, model gateway abstraction across all providers, governed tool invocation, and configurable per-agent guardrails (cost ceilings, timeouts, blast radius limits).

Build the MCP connector ecosystem. Own the strategy for standardized, bidirectional connectors various systems of record. Drive on behalf of identity propagation, idempotency, dry-run/preview mode, and a connector SDK that lets domain teams onboard new systems without platform changes.

Ship the evaluation and quality framework. Own the AI-judge evaluation pipeline: offline eval with golden datasets, online LLM-as-judge scoring, domain-specific judges (Finance, HR, Legal, Sales), and mandatory evaluation gates in CI/CD. No agent reaches production without passing quality and safety thresholds.

Define the federation and adoption model. Establish the three tiers of adoption (platform built, domain built on platform, citizen developer edge apps) with governance checkpoints at each gate. Drive the gold-standard promotion pipeline from edge prototype to production hardened service.

sections.title: What we look for:
bullets: 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years on internal platform, infrastructure, or developer-experience products.

Deep experience building platforms that other teams build on you understand the difference between a platform and an application, and you have opinions about API design, developer ergonomics, and self service.

Demonstrated experience with AI/ML platforms, agent frameworks, LLM-powered applications, or agentic systems. You know what an agent runtime is, what RAG means in practice, and why evaluation is the hardest part.

Strong technical foundation you can read architecture diagrams, discuss trade offs with engineers (e.g., sync vs. async, checkpointing strategies, context window management), and make informed prioritization decisions on deeply technical work.
Experience defining and shipping developer experiences: SDKs, CLIs, templates, documentation, and self service workflows. You measure success by adoption and developer NPS, not feature count.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across 4+ teams without direct authority. You influence through clarity, conviction, and stakeholder alignment.
Strong written communication strategy documents, PRDs, and executive briefs that drive alignment at VP and CIO level.
Comfort with ambiguity, you will define the roadmap for capabilities that don't exist yet, in a space that is evolving weekly.

sections.title: Nice to have:
bullets: Experience with Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, Unity Catalog, MLflow, or Delta Lake.
Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent-to-Agent), or AG-UI protocols.
Experience building AI evaluation frameworks LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, or automated quality scoring.
Experience with design systems, component libraries, or frontend platform work.
Background in enterprise SaaS platform consolidation or migration.

We’re committed to delivering the industry’s most reliable, actionable, and differentiated insights and empowering the innovators and organizations transforming healthcare. Because when our customers succeed, healthcare improves—for everyone.

sections.title: About the Role

We are hiring a Solutions Consultant, Digital Audiences to sit alongside our Life Sciences sales team and grow digital audience revenue inside our existing customer base.

This is a hybrid role: part commercial seller, part practitioner-level expert in healthcare audience strategy and activation. Time is split roughly evenly between internal and external work. Internally, you’ll identify prospects and work with Account Executives to set up meetings and qualify digital audience opportunities across their accounts. Externally, you lead audience strategy conversations with pharma, biotech, medical device, and diagnostics marketers - translating their commercial objectives into targeting, activation, and measurement approaches our platform can deliver.

This is not an overlay or post-sale support function. You carry a number, you are measured on the revenue you help create, and you are expected to be in accounts and in deals. This is a highly cross-functional role working with Sales, Product, Digital Operations, Enablement, and Marketing.

Join account planning sessions and shape the audience strategy inside each customer growth plan.
Run joint prospecting - outreach, discovery meetings, and customer workshops - to open conversations sellers cannot open alone.
Map new buyers beyond our traditional contacts: brand and digital marketing leads, media and omnichannel teams, and the budgets they control.

Frame our audience and activation capabilities credibly against agency, data provider, and DSP alternatives - including where we integrate rather than compete.

Design the solution and build the supporting business case, proposal content, and pricing rationale.
Present to customer stakeholders and clear the technical, measurement, and procurement objections that stall audience deals.

You’ll be a pivotal figure in helping Intercom scale its AI-driven support platform to some of the world’s most well-known brands. This role will shape how we engage with large, complex organizations, defining our go-to-market, building a world-class team, and delivering tangible customer outcomes through innovation and credibility.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a Solutions Engineering team focused on winning complex deals, creating vertical-specific solution architectures, and building repeatable playbooks. We believe in leaders who are open to be a player and a coach, regardless of seniority. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, and Services to deliver customer transformation through Intercom’s AI-first platform – be it through strategic guidance as a senior leader on the team, or securing deals with your own technical credibility where needed.

sections.title: What will I be doing?
bullets: Define and evolve the strategic vision and go-to-market (GTM) approach for the Solutions Engineering function.
Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing SE team across global regions and core verticals.
Operate as a player-coach, actively engaging in strategic deals while developing team capabilities.
Support complex, six-figure sales cycles with technical guidance, architecture, demos, and product evaluation support, as well as sales expertise.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor and executive point of contact for large customers.
Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D to shape verticalized GTM motions and solution strategy.
Champion a customer-obsessed culture across the pre-sales journey – from outbound to implementation.
Lead discovery, design, and delivery of tailored technical solutions, including PoCs and business value assessments.

bullets: 5+ years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer/Architect, or related individual contributor role.

greenhouse:komodohealth:8588487002.summary: At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.

sections.title: We Breathe Life Into Data
paras: As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.

sections.title: The Opportunity at Komodo Health:
paras: The Sales Engineering team partners with Sales to deliver expert technical support for Komodo's real-world data, AI-powered analytics, and software for our Life Sciences customers. We act as trusted advisors — bridging data and AI expertise with commercial strategy to help clients solve their most pressing challenges and reduce the burden of disease.

The Senior Sales Engineer provides technical, data, and AI-solution expertise across the discovery, qualification, value-alignment, and solution-design stages of the sales cycle. The through-line of the role is simple: help life sciences clients see a transformed workflow — analyses that used to take weeks, run live in minutes — and connect that directly to their commercial outcomes.

You are the kind of person who builds their own tools. You turn one-off analyses into reusable assets, automate your own workflow, and have spent real time hands-on with AI — building or experimenting with agents, apps, and analytics co-pilots. You don't wait for enablement to hand you a script; you build the thing yourself.

What you'll accomplish in your first 12 months:
bullets: Become a go-to expert for Komodo's AI-powered platform — routinely running live, plain-language analyses that compress weeks of work into minutes and shorten the path from discovery to close.
Develop deep fluency in Komodo's Healthcare Map and real-world data assets, and in how our analytics and AI products solve specific customer pain points.
Build a personal library of reusable, AI-centric demo assets and proof-of-value frameworks — and share them so the whole team moves faster.

Confidently articulate Komodo's trustworthy-AI approach — grounded, explainable, reproducible, verified, governed — to technical buyers, customer AI councils, and compliance/procurement stakeholders, clearing the AI-related blockers that stall deals.
Strengthen the Sales Engineering and Sales partnership through better discovery, qualification, and solution design — and surface cross-sell and expansion paths across the Komodo portfolio.
Build trusted client relationships by tying Komodo's data and AI capabilities to clients' commercial outcomes and ROI.

sections.title: These are the essential job duties you will be responsible for:
bullets: Partner with Sales during discovery to identify the technical, data, and AI requirements, pain points, and desired commercial outcomes for life sciences clients.
Provide expert guidance on healthcare claims and real-world data — clinical ontologies, identity resolution, patient-journey insights.
Design and present tailored solutions that combine Komodo's Healthcare Map, AI engine, and software products to meet client objectives — and quantify the business value.

Run technical and AI-powered demonstrations — live, plain-language analyses and no-code exploration — and handle the off-script, ad-hoc question with a real answer in the room rather than "we'll get back to you."
Position how Komodo's differentiated AI compares to general-purpose foundation models and other real-world-data vendors, addressing model trust, data provenance, reproducibility, and governance.
Support customer AI councils, security reviews, and enterprise procurement to unlock and accelerate larger, multi-product deals.
Identify and shape expansion opportunities across Komodo's products to grow account revenue.
Navigate the internal review process for technical proposals — aligning Legal, Compliance, Security / AI Governance, and Product.

sections.title: What you bring to Komodo Health (required):
bullets: Experience. 6+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Account Management, selling software, real-world data, and analytics to life sciences / pharmaceutical companies.

Domain depth. Deep familiarity with large BioPharma functional areas (e.g., Commercial, HEOR/RWE, Medical Affairs), their workflows, and how each thinks about data and budget — with a track record of driving material improvements within them.

A builder mentality. You create your own assets and tools and have hands-on experience building or experimenting with AI agents and applications (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, LangFlow, data-science notebooks). Production deployments are not required — demonstrated tinkering, resourcefulness, and a bias toward building are.

AI fluency. Working fluency with the AI/ML concepts relevant to enterprise analytics — LLMs, generative and agentic AI, retrieval-grounded analytics — and the ability to explain AI trust, reproducibility, and governance to both technical and non-technical buyers.

A strong data foundation. Deep understanding of healthcare claims and real-world data (e.g., 837/835 data, NDC codes, clinical ontologies); working SQL and Python; APIs, data integration, and cloud architectures (AWS, Azure). Experience with privacy-preserving linking is a plus.
The ability to demo and quantify. Demonstrated success demoing and positioning AI-powered analytics products and connecting their capabilities to measurable customer ROI.
Range as a communicator. You translate complex technical and AI concepts into clear, business-relevant insight, and connect equally well with executive and technical stakeholders.

greenhouse:moloco:8038077003.summary:
Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture) , the AI system behind every Moloco product.

sections.title: About Moloco:
paras: At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

sections.title: The impact you'll contribute to Moloco
paras: As Group Product Manager, Re-Engagement & Retargeting, you will own top-line revenue growth for Moloco's re-engagement and retargeting business, working across the end-to-end stack to drive performance improvements for Moloco clients. You will define and own the product roadmap for targeting, modeling and bid pricing, and work closely with partner teams across supply, creatives, measurement and advertiser experience.

You will own the full re-engagement and retargeting product: the campaign offering, the targeting and audience creation features advertisers use to define who they reach, and the AI automation that creates, manages and optimizes campaigns. You will partner closely with Moloco's machine learning and bidding teams to turn model improvements into better advertiser outcomes.

This is a high-impact role leading a fast-growing business inside Moloco Ads. You will partner with Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Creatives, Product Design and Go-to-Market teams to grow the business across commerce, consumer apps and gaming.

sections.title: The opportunity
paras: From re-engaging lapsed users on gaming and consumer apps to retargeting high-propensity users to drive transactions, audience-based campaigns play a key role in driving ROI for performance marketers. Moloco's CARA AI makes real-time decisions about user intent, conversion probability, creative fit and auction economics, combining behavioral and contextual signals to decide which users to show ads to, which ads to show them, and how much each user is worth to the advertiser. That requires audiences, signals, creative and bidding to work as one system, often where the most valuable user and conversion combinations are sparse or have never been observed.
You will also lead how advertisers create, manage and measure these campaigns, across traditional UI and API surfaces as well as native AI agents and MCP-powered workflows.
bullets: Ownership of a growing business, with accountability for revenue and advertiser outcomes
Product leadership for targeting, audience creation, re-engagement and retargeting, and the CARA AI optimization models behind them
Deep partnership with machine learning and bidding teams on technically complex systems
A hands-on role in building AI-driven campaign automation across UI and MCP workflows
Cross-functional leadership across a broad, globally distributed organization

sections.title: What you will do
bullets: Define the vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for re-engagement and retargeting across commerce, consumer apps and gaming.
Own the growth of the re-engagement business: set targets, identify the largest budget pools, and build the product capabilities and go-to-market motions that win them.
Own the targeting and audience creation feature set, including how advertisers build, size, share and refresh audiences.
Drive a performance flywheel: partner with ML and bidding teams to improve conversion and value models and bid pricing, and turn every campaign into better training data for the next.

Partner with Ads Experience teams to build AI campaign creation, management and optimization automation in Ads Manager and through MCP workflows, covering setup, configuration health, diagnostics and proactive recommendations.

Define how first-party signals, including conversion events, catalog data, mobile measurement partner data and web conversions, are collected, validated and used across targeting, training and bidding.
Work closely with our measurement and experimentation program, including incrementality, to build the evidence advertisers need to scale budgets.
Work with teams across the stack (creatives, identity, measurement, supply and bidding infrastructure) to find and fix the issues that limit end-to-end performance.

sections.title: About MongoDB
paras: MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

Define what is a reusable platform capability versus a mission- or customer-specific customization, and shape the architectural choices that make that distinction hold up across multiple missions and customers.
Sequence the roadmap so Muon wins near-term deals while compounding reusable value for future ones.
Define how success is measured for the area and hold the organization accountable to it.

Productization & commercial decisions


• Own the productization decisions for your area. Drive the shift from bespoke, project-based commitments toward standardized, tiered offerings. This is a primary ROI vector for the role in every area.

Concretely, depending on area:


• Spacecraft platform — define platform variants, standard interfaces, and the menu of options exposed to mission teams and customers; govern how the platform evolves across missions without fragmenting into one-offs.

Bits-to-ground — define latency, availability, and throughput tiers end-to-end from downlink to delivery; align ground segment, pipeline, and storage investments against those commitments; set downlink prioritization policy across the constellation.

On-board high-performance compute — define the on-board compute capability roadmap, the developer/SDK surface for mission payloads, and how on-board processing is exposed to internal mission teams and external customers (edge inference, on-board data reduction, tipping-and-cueing).

sections.title: About the team
paras: The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale—$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.

Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.

sections.title: The access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right

Own the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors
Own visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired

sections.title: Provisioning and integrations: let the system run itself

Partner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does

Calling is at the heart of the Intercom experience, and we need a product manager to own it end to end: every call, from the moment someone presses the button to the moment someone answers and helps them.

smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001568421.summary:
A Regional Product Manager (RPM) connects global product strategy to execution in a specific market. Product managers build features and own the core roadmap with engineering teams. An RPM takes that roadmap into one market, adapts it to local customers, regulations, and buying patterns, and owns its commercial success there. At ServiceNow, RPM markets are defined by geography, industry, or customer segment.

In this role, you will own one industry or customer segment in the Americas. You will be the person responsible for how ServiceNow's AI products are positioned, sold, adopted, and improved in that market. This is an individual contributor (IC) role, reporting to the leader of Regional Product Management for the Americas.

sections.title: Regional strategy and adaptation
bullets: Translate the global AI product roadmap into a plan for your industry or segment
Tailor use cases, solution packages, and messaging to the operational problems your customers care about most
Account for industry regulations and compliance requirements in how solutions are positioned and deployed
Track AI adoption trends in your market and adjust priorities as they shift

sections.title: Go-to-market and sales enablement
bullets: Partner with sales, marketing, and channel partners to launch AI products into your market
Run discovery on priority deals and shape buying criteria and deal sizing toward AI early in the sales cycle
Build discovery guides, use case catalogs, demo stories, and value stories that sellers can reuse
Make sure AI use cases go live after every win, working with customer success, professional services, and partners on success criteria, go-live dates, and adoption metrics

sections.title: Commercial strategy and financial targets
bullets: Own the commercial strategy for your market, including product mix, packaging, and deal structure, to meet revenue and margin targets
Set and own quarterly targets for deals in motion, AI attach, and discovery completed before close
Work with pricing teams on packaging and discount guidance suited to your customers

sections.title: Voice of the customer
bullets: Act as the technical and commercial expert in the field for your market
Gather customer feedback and turn repeated needs into solution requirements for product teams
Test emerging AI ideas with customers and bring the ones with traction to the teams that build new products
Represent ServiceNow with customer executives, at industry events, and in customer advisory sessions
